Monday, November 29, 2021  7:00 PM  Teleconference

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that a Special Meeting of the Equestrian Committee of the City of Rolling Hills
Estates will be held on Monday, November 29, 2021 at 7:00 p.m. via Teleconference. The agenda for the special
meeting with the items to be discussed is set forth below.

  Posted by the office of the City Clerk on Monday, November 22, 2021
  In accordance with Assembly Bill 361 (AB 361) and the continuing state of emergency, including masking
  and social distancing directives as a result of the threat of the COVID-19 virus, this meeting is being held
  remotely via teleconference. There will not be a physical location for this meeting. Members of the public
  may participate in the meeting in the following ways:

  - Members of the public may listen to the meeting live by calling: (1-669-900-6833) from any phone,
  Meeting ID: 843 8698 5214, Meeting Password: 339794. (Please note you will not have the ability to
  speak using the call-in option from a phone line.)

  - Members of the public may comment online using eComment on the “Meeting Agendas, Minutes &
  Videos” page of the City’s website (www.rhe.city/agendas). Once the agenda is published, there will be an
  “eComment” button next to the linked agenda under "Upcoming Events". Follow this link to the City’s
  SpeakUp page. After you register, you may comment on any item on that particular agenda. These
  comments can be seen by the public, will be considered by the Committee and become part of the record.

  - Members of the public who wish to speak during this meeting may join the Zoom meeting by accessing the
  Zoom app from a computer (downloaded at Zoom.com) or tablet or phone (downloaded in the App Store),
  by entering the following credentials: Meeting ID: 843 8698 5214, Meeting Password: 339794. Members
  of the public who join the Zoom meeting will not have video, and may request to speak using the following
  process: After joining the Zoom meeting, if you wish to speak, please select the "raise hand" option at the
  lower portion of your screen. The Meeting Host will send you a chat message to identify which item on the
  agenda you would like to speak on and will unmute your mic at the appropriate time.

  Agenda reports and other disclosable public records relating to each agenda item are available on the
  City's website under Meeting Agendas, Minutes & Videos at www.rhe.city/agendas.

minutes_text:
SPECIAL EQUESTRIAN COMMITTEE MEETING
  MINUTES
  November 29, 2021

1.  CALL TO ORDER
A special meeting of the Equestrian Committee of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was
called to order by CHAIR HUFF at 7:05 P.M. via teleconference, pursuant to the
Governor’s Executive Order N-29-20.
2.  ROLL CALL
Committee Members Present:  Huff, Brtis, Ciarolla, Griggs, Nilsen, Shinn, Silvano,
  Robinson
Committee Members Absent:  Harik, Martin, Zigrang
City Staff Present:  Assistant City Manager, Alexa Davis
  Community Services Supervisor, Rosa Pinuelas
  Maintenance Superintendent, Mike Goldsmith
3. APPROVAL OF MINUTES
  MEMBER GRIGGS moved, seconded by MEMBER BRTIS, to:
  APPROVE THE DRAFT MINUTES OF THE OCTOBER 25, 2021
  EQUESTRIAN COMMITTEE MEETING AS PRESENTED.
There being no objection, CHAIR HUFF so ordered.
4.  AUDIENCE ITEMS WRITTEN /ORAL COMMUNICATIONS NOT ON AGENDA
None.
5.  STAFF ITEMS

  A. TRAIL RIDING OPERATION PERMIT REVIEW
Assistant City Manager Davis provided an overview of the written staff report. The
Committee agreed with staff recommendation with minor modifications to the permit for
a one-year permit and businesses license for 2022.

As a member of the public, Councilmember Debby Stegura provided comment noting that
a community meeting of stakeholders was held earlier in the month which included City
staff, City of Palos Verdes Estates (PVE) staff, PV Stable Operator, and Rolling Hills
Estates and Palos Verdes Estates neighbors to address the continued concerns
recognized at the stable property. These include addressing parking concerns, gathering
EQUESTRIAN COMMITTEE MEETING
NOVEMBER 29, 2021
  1
 of people adjacent to residential adjacent properties, PVE’s conditional use permit
process for approving its trail riding structure and associated notification and opportunities
to mitigate impacts. Councilmember Debby Stegura shared that City staff and PVE staff
continue to work toward some prompt resolutions but noted that PVE has a staffing
shortage that has caused some delays in response. Chair Huff thanked
Councilmember Stegura for this update and suggested that if needed, the City may want
to form a subcommittee of Councilmembers if a resolution is not met soon.

MEMBER NILSEN MOVED, seconded by MEMBER SILVANO for the permit to be
approved administratively with the modification to permit to state:

  Day trail riding operation may begin on Rolling Hills Estates trails no earlier than
  9 a.m. with the last group commencing no later than 5 p.m. or dusk, whichever is
  earlier, Monday through Sunday

There being no objection, Chair Huff so ordered.

  B. EQUESTRIAN ISSUES LOG
MEMBER SHINN asked if the consideration permanent installation of western barrels can
return to the Committee for discussion. Superintendent Goldsmith explained that there
are gymkhana poles by the judge’s booth at Ernie Howlett Arenas. MEMBER SHINN
asked if the barrels could be stored easily. MEMBER SILVANO expressed concern that
temporary barrels could be carried away easily. MEMBER ROBINSON asked if there
has been a big interested in the community for barrel racing. MEMBER SHINN responded
that it was brought up to her personally, but she understood the maintenance concerns;
she further explained she believed that they were available in the past. Staff confirmed
that the item will return to the Committee for consideration.

MEMBER GRIGGS asked about a white paint spill on Silver Spur/Palos Verdes Drive
North and if the paint is permanent on the asphalt, and also mentioned that there is a lid
stuck as a result of the paint. Superintendent Goldsmith responded that he was aware
and will see about getting the stuck lid removed, however the paint is unable to be
removed and will fade over time.

  C. DECEMBER MEETING DATE (VERBAL REPORT)

Assistant City Manager Davis shared that the next regular meeting was scheduled for
December 27th and that Staff recommended the Committee consider cancelling the
December meeting and meet next on January 24, 2022. The Committee agreed with
staff’s recommendation to cancel the December meeting.

6. COMMITTEE REPORTS

A.  TRAIL (VERBAL REPORT)
EQUESTRIAN COMMITTEE MEETING
NOVEMBER 29, 2021
  2
 MEMBER GRIGGS reported that on Ferncreek trail by Masongate/Ferncreek, there
were some sprinklers overflowing onto the trail causing it to be slippery. Superintendent
Goldsmith responded that maintenance will inspect the area.

B. MATTERS OF INTEREST (VERBAL REPORT)

MEMBER SHINN requested that there be an update on the Chandler Park playground
review. Assistant City Manager Davis responded that an interest survey is being
developed and a final draft will be presented to the Park and Activities Commission in
December. Staff will share the survey with the Committee once it is final.

Assistant City Manager also shared that Chandler Arena hours have been temporarily
modified and signs will be going up to inform users.

7. FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

A.  AMBASSADOR PROGRAM

This item will come back to the Committee with more details.

B.  EQUESTRIAN EMERGENCY PREPAREDNESS

This item will come back to the Committee with an update.

8. ADJOURNMENT

CHAIR HUFF adjourned the Equestrian Committee meeting 7:58 P.M.

Respectfully submitted,  Approved,

__________________________  __________________________
Alexa Davis  Britt Huff, Chair
Assistant City Manager
